objective: Versioned Aiken corpus for old-versus-new codegen comparison, Lean-blaster equivalence checking, and complete mapped Aiken v1.1.23 feature coverage.
screening_caveat: This is a versioned coverage contract, not a successful build report. Coverage remains unverified until source scanning, both compiler builds, UPLC extraction, and every required lane finish.

priority_definitions.P0: Direct, high-value Aiken packages. Favor these for the first automated build and equivalence wave.
priority_definitions.P1: Strong expansion candidates. They may use a nested workspace, several packages, a historical compiler pin, or a library harness.
priority_definitions.P2: Broad coverage candidates. These are mainly small examples, educational projects, archived code, or compiler and regression fixtures.

intake_definitions.root: An Aiken package appears at the repository root.
intake_definitions.root-or-discover: Start at the root, then search for aiken.toml if required.
intake_definitions.nested: A known or apparent Aiken package is in a subdirectory.
intake_definitions.nested-or-discover: Search likely subdirectories for the package root.
intake_definitions.multi-package: The repository contains or appears to contain several Aiken packages.
intake_definitions.harness: The repository is mainly a library or corpus. Add a small validator harness.
intake_definitions.harness-or-root: Try the root package first. Add a harness if it has no buildable validator.
intake_definitions.special: The project needs a special compiler, generator, fork, or version-specific workflow.
intake_definitions.discover: The package path was not confirmed. Search for aiken.toml and validators.

status_definitions.repository-page-screened: The current repository page or current search result was checked for Aiken relevance. This is not a successful clone or build.
status_definitions.not-build-verified: The repository came from the 2024 public Aiken census and was not individually revalidated during this pass.

source_of_truth: v1.1.23 tagged AST and parser source

coverage_contract.goal: Exercise every mapped Aiken v1.1.23 language and compiler surface plus every active UPLC builtin.
coverage_contract.pass_condition: Every positive row and builtin has verified evidence in all required lanes. Every negative row has the expected diagnostic under both compiler variants.
coverage_contract.version_pair_rule: The newer compiler defines the inventory. Only rows accepted by both compilers and emitted as UPLC by both compilers enter Lean-blaster.

execution_lanes.compile: Parse and type-check the same pinned source with both compiler variants.
execution_lanes.blaster: Build reachable validator UPLC with both compiler variants and compare the pair with Lean-blaster.
execution_lanes.check: Run unit, property, and validator tests with fixed options and seeds.
execution_lanes.bench: Discover and run benchmark definitions with the same Sampler inputs.
execution_lanes.config: Exercise target, environment, configuration, dependency, lockfile, and monorepo selection.
execution_lanes.docs: Exercise source documentation generation. This lane does not enter Blaster.

baseline.scope_rule: Only forms accepted by the tagged lexer, parser, type checker, project loader, and active UPLC builtin enum are positive baseline features.

public_sources.role: Authoritative grammar, AST, active builtin inventory, diagnostics, and acceptance packages.

required_internal_source.role: Required stable fixture repository. It closes all gaps and prevents dead-code-only coverage.

supplemental_public_source.reason: Useful for scanning, but prefer the completed answer package for mandatory execution.

metadata_source.reason: Index only; not one compile target.

mandatory_corpus.coverage_rule: Repository presence does not count. Static evidence and every required execution lane must pass.
mandatory_corpus.version_pair_rule: Use the newer compiler to define the inventory. Send only shared, two-sided UPLC builds to Lean-blaster. Record new-only and removed forms as compatibility results.
